shipLog.text: ◆ Welcome aboard! At any stop, STOP opens the Stop menu! Mine, scan, rest, repair, trade! Each one takes time and effort! RESUME flies us on!
◆ The crop is in! ARIA has declared it the finest crop in recorded history! She has not looked up recorded history!
Arrived at Candidate Alpha! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
◆ The ship computer has started calling the wheat "humanity's oldest crewmate." Ten thousand years of harvests, and it sounds almost fond.
The Paperwork: we chose “Sign everything without reading”. Love that for us!
You signed. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ We have materials! ARIA has ideas! The FABRICATOR, from the Stop menu, prints hull patches, repair kits and more! Each print wears it a little!
Arrived at Route Decision! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
Footnotes: we chose “Port — "mostly" is an honest word”. Love that for us!
You take the lane that admits its flaws. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ We have stuff in the hold! INV opens it! You can USE things, see which events they open, sell them when docked, or throw them out the airlock! ARIA would never!
Arrived at Planet McPlanetface! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (2/3). The colony office will want this.
The Green One: we chose “Observe from the ship and leave”. Love that for us!
You watched from orbit. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Tip! The readout strip under the gauges opens ORDERS! Pace, rations and the water split! ARIA likes LUDICROUS! ARIA has been told not to choose!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 25% grown, health 100. Thriving!
Arrived at Crossroads (The Space Version)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
The Halfway Shop: we chose “Buy the survival kit”. Love that for us!
The survival kit is heavier than it looks and contains… +6 FOOD, +4 H2O, −12 GOLD, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ A STATION! With people! ARIA loves stations! Dock for the market and the rooms, and the Stop menu has MEDBAY, DRYDOCK and FAB SERVICE while you're here!
Arrived at The Green One! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (3/3). The colony office will want this.
Spot Check: we chose “Pay the 'inspection fee' — 12 gold”. Love that for us!
The fee is accepted, the clipboard signed, the shears holstered. −12 GOLD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
◆ The crop card opens the GROWBAY! Water, tending, threats, and TREAT for pests! ARIA visits every day!
Arrived at Port Authority (Disputed)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −5 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 7 DAYS. Lovely view!
Passenger Manifest: One (1)…: we chose “Confine them until the next stop”. Love that for us!
You assign them quarters and a schedule that keeps them out of the… −4 MORALE, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ MAP shows the whole trail! Where we are, where we're going, all the forks! The ??? stops are surprises! SCAN tells you what's coming!
The Wheat hit FLOWERING! 57% grown, health 100. Thriving!

identity.name: Meridian Slate
identity.story: They are a corporate auditor. They boarded secretly to audit the mission in situ, which is even less legal than stowing away, a point they concede while showing you a briefcase full of forms about your fuel consumption. The company does not know they are here. The company, they add quietly, does not know a lot of things.
identity.line: Before you decide anything: your ration accounting is impeccable. I checked. I couldn't help it.
identity.join_note: No shipboard skills whatsoever. Fills out arrival paperwork so well the colony office may weep.

fee.detail: Returnable, in theory. The form is on backorder.
